about_the_game:
Game Introduction

I don't know when, but a mysterious and strange story has been circulating in the school.

After 7 pm, the school will prohibit students from entering or leaving.

If the lights on each floor of the unmanned teaching building are turned on one after another, you will hear the sound of tripping.

After the extinguished lights start flashing, do not act recklessly.

The 'never seen inspector' will come to arrest every student who stays without permission.

In order to uncover the truth behind the mysterious and bizarre story, the five members of the band quietly infiltrated the first teaching building of the art department.

Overview statement

This work is a derivative game of the second creation of the virtual idol group PLAYE.

The game content is free and publicly available for players to play and communicate with, and does not include any built-in purchasing items.

The main characters and content of the show are all members (Yejun, Noah, Bamby, Eunho, Hamin), and the rest of the characters are original NPCs required for the plot.

The character copyright belongs to Vlast, and all materials used in the game are self-made or purchased.

Except for the characters and some settings, the world view and plot of this game are all fictional settings set by the author.

Due to the fact that the plot of this game is mostly fictional, there will be a relatively complete introduction, and players who are not familiar with PLAVE can also experience it as a regular campus kaidan game.

This game is positioned as a general fan oriented game, with a storyline centered around all players and excluding CP. Character interpretation is based on the author's personal understanding, and we apologize for any deviations.

This story is purely fictional, and the regions, characters, groups, legends, etc. in the story have no relation to the actual things that exist.

The game theme is campus suspense+micro horror, and the gameplay mode is text+exploration, with a certain horror atmosphere and a small amount of bloody and violent text description.

It is recommended to play for players aged 16 and above. Players under 18 and those who are timid should play with caution.

GAME PLAY

Players do not have a specific role to play, and the game will switch between the perspectives of each member to advance the plot, involving certain differences in choices and investigation and collection. Collecting specific props can unlock corresponding keywords in the file. Multiple endings can be entered based on the selected options.

 

Special gameplay

The game performance adopts 2.5D character illustrations and a small amount of animation to display the plot, and the artistic content is subject to the author's creativity.

【Staff】

Producer: Tempestad

Game Engine: GameCreator

Program: Tempestad

Script: Tempestad

Copy proofreading: Quanju Foski

Scene concept: Michellenaya

Scene original painting: Michellenaya, みくる, Tempestad (processed drawing)

Character&CG original artwork: TempestadPV

Animation: Tempestad

UI Art: Maot

Logo Design: Dfr

Music/Commercial Music Library: MIKIILO, Crow Producer/Envato Market

Sound source: Freesound，耳聆网

short_description: Virtual group - PLAVE doujin game, with winter campus kaidan as the theme. Players will explore the seven incredible night patrol rules on campus from the perspectives of five members, uncovering the terrifying truth behind mysterious and bizarre stories through investigation and selection.
